notes.title: Taco Amigos is Now Available!
notes.content:
Good day, chefs! It's finally time: today we open our very own Mexican restaurant! Taco Amigos, the new campaign (single and coop) for Diner Bros, is now available!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32619230/386deb26ba8cf0a6cf34f58715b9e1b3ea730f8c.png

Here's what awaits you in Taco Amigos:
Cook brand new Mexican recipes: burritos, beans, rice, salsa… and of course, tacos!
Serve new drinks: soda and tequila
Attend to 5 new special customers, including Muertos, Luchador, and Mariachi
Expand your restaurant with new kitchen equipment and items
Hire helpers: SOFÍA can chop and LUCÍA will help too!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1252980/Diner_Bros__Taco_Amigos_Campaign/
Are you a little rusty and haven't cooked with us in a while? Don't miss out on our little buddies and masked amigos.  And if you want to be a super star, leave a review for Diner Bros and Taco Amigos -- let others know how much you love cooking!

Discord | Twitter

notes.title: Sushi Bros is available!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32619230/4467c2bc0699262d18a5901da80426d239186b78.jpg

Good day, chefs! The day has come: today you can open your very own Japanese restaurant! Sushi Bros, the new campaign (single and coop) for Diner Bros, is now available! 

Here's what you will find in Sushi Bros: 


 Cook brand new Japanese recipes: rice, edamame, maki, sashimi, nigiri, grilled fish, yakitori, soy sauce… and of course, sushi!
 Serve new drinks: tea and sake
 Expand your restaurant with a fishing pier…
 …and catch your own fish!
 Attend to 4 new special customers, including Mr. Kabuki and Princess Hime
 New equipment and items for your kitchen


But that's not all! We are also happy to announce that we have also added a new split-screen Versus mode for you to play against your friends to find out who's the fastest and most efficient chef. This new Versus mode is included in the base game for free! Enjoy your cooking duels!

If you want to help us, leave us your review of Diner Bros and Sushi Bros -- let others know how much you love cooking!

notes.title: Pizza Bros is here!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32619230/ac85888a1200a01fddf84ed11b9b76e06706a1a8.jpg

Welcome, chefs! During these past months we've paid a lot of attention to your feedback (thanks a lot!), and one thing was very clear: you wanted more -- of everything! More recipes to cook, more ingredients to chop and mix, more drinks to pour, more clients to serve... As our Discord subscribers know, we've been in the kitchen for some time now, working in some tasty new content for Diner Bros, and today we are happy to announce today the release of Pizza Bros, our first major update! 

Pizza Bros is a brand new campaign for Diner Bros where you manage a pizza joint. There are new dishes for you to cook, new special customers, new items and food processors... and on top of that, new challenge levels for you to test your skills and reflexes! Oh, and something very important: Pizza Bros is totally free! Enjoy your pizzas! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HlLCZQryX-w
NEW FEATURES 

 New pizza restaurant
 New bro: the Italian chef
 New customers: The lumberjack who eats a lot, the diva, the thief... and more surprises!
 New recipes: pizza, bread, roasted potatoes
 New ingredients: pepperoni, mushrooms, white wine, coffee
 New kitchen items

notes.title: Halloween Update: Zombie Bros!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32619230/a069fb078edb4225bb7a2970021f321869b810a6.jpg

Good day, chefs! Remember the weird guy that had us cowering for days? Turns out he was a zombie -- and there are hundreds and hundreds like him coming to Diner Bros! As long as we keep them fed it should be fine... 

We're spooked to announce our Halloween Update featuring Zombie Bros, a new endless level where hordes of zombies will keep coming to your restaurant -- keep them fed and happy to survive as long as you can. And to celebrate this update, Diner Bros will have a tasty  -15% discount for a few days!

There are some more quality of life changes included in this update, make sure to check the patch notes below. Happy Halloween to you all! 

NEW FEATURES

New Endless Level: Zombie Bros!
New Achievements: Zombie Bros I, II & III

CHANGES

Added rolling pin to smack dine and dashers!
Punks can only be caught when they are sneaking away
Modified hit boxes on Punks
Beer icon is now darker to differentiate it from Yellow Drink icon
Reduced Quest requirements

Baked potatoes: 20 --> 15
Beer: 25 --> 15
Burgers: 100 --> 90
Dessert: 35 --> 25

Reduced Achievement requirements

Hard Worker: 50 --> 40
Artsy Fartsy: 20--> 15
Dine and Dash: 25--> 20

Added Endless select screen
Added Divas & Artists to Stats screen

notes.title: Korean Localization and Hardcore Levels
notes.content:
Good day chefs! We've been busy in the kitchen for a few weeks, and we're happy to bring some new and tasty content to your tables: today Diner Bros receives a new update! The first thing we want to announce is that now Diner Bros is fully localized to Korean! Korean gamers have supported us since its release, and we wanted to give back some of that love. To all our players from there: 고맙습니다! We're also adding a fan-made Czech translation; huge kudos and thanks to its author, David Koncivny!

But that's not all, folks! For those of you who have tested your skills with the knife and pan by impressing all the critics and beating both the campaign and the Challenge Level, here you have 2 new hardcore levels that will put your cool, skill, and reflexes to a test. Good luck with them -- you're going to need it... but as they say, if you can't stand the heat, get out of the kitchen! 

There are some other changes in this update, such as a new secret achievement and some quality-of-life fixes. You will find a comprehensive list below. Enjoy the update, and bon appétit!

NEW FEATURES

5 New Challenge Levels! Including 2 hardcore levels
New Achievement: Triple Chop [Secret]
New Languages: Korean, Czech (Fan Translation)

CHANGES

Increased difficulty of "Quadathlon" and "King of Punks"
Reduced frequency of Divas in campaign and endless mode
Larger hitbox on Punks (Should make it easier to catch them!)

FIXES

The endless mode achievements will now correctly unlock ("Is that all?" and "I ain't even tired").  If you have already met the requirements, start and finish an endless game with any score to unlock them.
Fixed character select screen freeze that would occur with multiple controllers
The message "The Critic was not Impressed" will now correctly show up
Fixed inverted DPad for multiple controllers
Starting a new game in easy mode will now correctly set the game's difficulty

notes.title: Monthversary Update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32619230/ef3dd9cb6e8d0e5f07bf37c9d59ff5d9d253fe19.jpg

Good day chefs! It's been one month since we released Diner Bros, and we want to thank you all for your support. But as we told you when we opened the doors of this restaurant, opening day was but the first step on a long journey for a game that will keep growing and receiving new content over the next months. To celebrate the first month on Steam, we're releasing today our Monthversary Update with new features, such as 11 new challenge levels, a new Special Costumer, a new Endless Mode, and many new achievements -- along with some quality of life fixes and changes. Check out the full patch notes below. And to mark this occasion, we're happy to announce that Diner Bros will be -10% off for a few days. Bon appétit!

NEW FEATURES


11 New Challenge Levels! Now including HARDCORE levels
New Special Customer! The Diva will begin visiting after obtaining 2 stars
Endless Mode! How long can you last? Unlocked after obtaining 3 stars
The Burger Trophy! Can be purchased after obtaining 3 stars
Auto-run! Activate this feature in the Options Menu
New Achievements:

     Diva Tantrum
     Keep 'em coming!
     Is that all?
     I ain't even tired!
     Challenge III
     The Golden Burger (Secret!)


CHANGES

The Artist:

     The Old Artist behavior has been assigned to the Diva.  The New Artist will now arrive part way through the 2 star restaurant with a new behavior.
     The Diva/Old Artist patience has been increased
     The Diva/Old Artist will no longer order "Chicken and Fries"

Challenge Mode:

     Now playable solo.  Solo players have a faster sprint and can hold multiple items.  Levels marked as "2+" are still co-op only.
     Increased difficulty (Challenge mode should be challenging!)

Food Critic:

     Will now be satisfied if his order is completed (Previously, he had to be served quickly leading to difficulty in the final stages)
     Arrives slightly earlier

Updated achievement icons

FIXES

Character Select now remembers the last character each player picked
Improved aiming/movement (Feedback appreciated!)
Improved balancing (1-2 players slightly easier, 3-4 players slightly harder)
Changed location of star counter in challenge mode
Customers won't emote "no" when player serves a drink while multi-holding 2 drink types

notes.title: Update 1.16: Mouse Support and Easy Mode
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32619230/b256ba29ff1242673ae98a915fcbdec22efa8ec9.jpg

Thank you for all your support this past weekend.  Based on your feedback we have implemented alternative controls for keyboard users and an optional easy mode.  With these changes, we hope that players of all skill levels can enjoy the game from start to finish.  As always, both modes may need to be adjusted in the future.  Your comments are very much appreciated.  Remember that you can send us your feedback via our official Steam forums and our social media channels (Twitter and Facebook). Bon appétit!

Update 1.16 Change Log

Changes

Easy Mode: Removed 4 & 5 star quest requirements, added simple quests, increased customer wait times, reduced customer frequency.
Mouse Control: Keyboard players can use the mouse to interact.  Use the arrow keys to get close and then LCLICK to pick up/drop and RCLICK to interact.

Bug Fixes

Fixed bug where player could not advance in the tutorial.
Fixed bug where character could face a different direction than player input.
